hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the univariate family L(n, x) = K(n, x) with the first argument n held fixed. The two target expressions are obtained by specializing the second argument x to m and n, respectively.
required_assumptions: No additional assumptions beyond the declared symbols and function K.
hypotheses.rationale: Both terms are evaluations of the same two-argument function K with an identical first argument n, differing only in the second argument. This forms a one-parameter family indexed by the second argument, and the piecewise expression selects one member based on the condition Ne(n,m).
